key_facts: Aug 11 UPDATE (T+1d; Exa Gulf Insider 2026-08-11 + Oman Observer/Times of Oman/Al Jazeera/Reuters Aug 10-11; UPDATED Oman 0.97->0.99, Yemen 0.02->0.01, dropped Iran): Oman Environment Authority Chairman Dr Abdullah bin Ali Al Amri confirmed on Oman TV (Aug 11) that no oil has yet been observed on mainland beaches (impact so far confined to Qibliyah Island), but Oman raised its National Oil Spill Contingency Plan from Level 1 to Level 2. Satellite analysis confirms the 390 sq km slick extends 449 km NORTHEAST from Hallaniyat Islands to within ~7 km of Oman mainland and is projected to drift another ~121 km northeast over 48 hours under 35-40 knot SW khareef monsoon winds directly toward Ras Madrakah (Oman mainland, Al Wusta Governorate). Yemen is >300 km southwest upwind and Iran is >800 km away. Conditional on confirmed mainland contamination by Aug 13, Oman is >99%; updated to Oman 0.99, Yemen 0.01 (sum 1.00).
next_review_trigger: FINAL DAY Aug 12: Monitor Oman Environment Authority / ONA / Times of Oman / Reuters for formal confirmation of Oman mainland (Ras Madrakah / Al Wusta) coastline oil contamination.
